patch_description: Align the input-side parameter sharing with the stronger prior programs: share RY amplitudes across graph-related vertices while retaining qubit-specific RZ phases. Remove the underperforming ZZZ interaction, which adds capacity and depth while the current model already overfits. Finally, move the shared mixing layer after all CZ interactions and use RY rather than RX, creating a compact trainable output-basis layer similar to the best prior architecture without adding its costly second phase layer.
